intro: I'm a third-year Mechatronics Engineering student, in the Biomedical dual degree, at Western University in London, Ontario. Most of my work is in embedded systems, robotics and biomedical devices: ESP32 firmware for sensors, mechanisms and enclosures in CAD, and control loops for things that move.
seeking: I'm looking for a 16-month co-op starting in Summer 2027.

education.degree: Bachelor of Engineering Science, Mechatronics Engineering (Biomedical dual degree)

bullets: Lead a team of engineering students in the design, simulation and programming of autonomous robotic systems.
Coordinate project timelines, manage technical resources and run design reviews.
Designed a polycentric hinge for a 3D-printed smart knee brace using Onshape and SolidWorks.
Iterated quickly on prototypes through 3D printing, working with the electrical team so the physical design supported the platform's electrical architecture.
Lead a team of 20 students and mentor them on the engineering design process.
Developed and tuned a PID control algorithm through iterative bench testing to improve the speed, stability and error correction of a line-following robot.
Programmed navigation logic in C++ and implemented sensor feedback loops for precise motion control.
